readOnly: The server's settings file is newer than this Reframe or cannot be read, so changes would not be saved. The settings are shown read-only.

tools.title: Tools
tools.intro: The programs Reframe runs. Where each one comes from: an environment variable on the server, a path in the settings, the bundled build, or the system PATH.
tools.useBundledAlso: Use bundled also removes the path of {tools}.
tools.bundledUseless: Environment variables on the server set ffmpeg and ffprobe, so a bundled FFmpeg would not be used.
tools.envNote: The environment variable {variable} on the server sets this path. To change it, change or unset the variable there and restart the server.
tools.webNote: A browser cannot choose the programs the server runs. Set {variable} on the server, or the path in the server's settings file.
tools.outdated: This release pins another version of the build {name}. The installed one keeps working until you download the new one.
tools.mismatchTitle: Some encoders need newer system software than this FFmpeg build expects
tools.mismatchHelp: Update the driver, or use another build: download one below, install one from a file, or set the path of your own FFmpeg.

encoders.title: Encoders
encoders.neverChecked: The encoders have not been checked yet.
encoders.fromCache: The statuses come from the cache and have not been checked again yet.
encoders.hardwareTestsHelp: Encode a few frames with each hardware encoder to find out whether it works. Off: hardware encoders stay "not tested".
encoders.vaapiHelp: Automatic tests the VAAPI encoders on every render node and uses the first one where each works. Choose a node to force it, for example on a computer with two GPUs.
encoders.tableCaption: Every encoder Reframe knows, with its status

output.title: Output
output.collisionHelp: Ask: the job stops and asks. Auto-rename: adds a number to the name. Overwrite: replaces the file.
output.partialHelp: What happens to the unfinished output file when a job fails or is cancelled.

languages.title: Languages
languages.favouritesHelp: Shown first, in this order, in every language picker.
languages.preferredAudioHelp: Used, in this order, by the audio defaults of a preset that names no languages of its own. Empty: every audio track is kept.
languages.preferredSubtitleHelp: Used, in this order, by the subtitle defaults of a preset that names no languages of its own. Empty: every subtitle track is kept.
languages.refusedTag: The server did not accept “{tag}”: a language tag is letters and digits in parts joined by hyphens, such as hu, pt-BR or sr-Latn.

preview.title: Preview
preview.sampleFramesHelp: How many evenly spaced frames the preview strip and crop detection use, from 1 to 60.
preview.cacheLimitHelp: Frames and preview clips share this space on the server. When it is full, the least recently used files are removed first.
preview.sizeUnknown: The cache size is not known.

queue.title: Queue
queue.parallelHelp: How many jobs encode at the same time.
queue.whenDoneHelpWeb: Sleep and Shut down act on the server's computer, after a countdown that can be cancelled.
queue.whenDoneHelpDesktop: Quit, Sleep and Shut down start after a countdown that can be cancelled.
queue.sleepInhibitHelp: Stops automatic sleep while jobs run. Your own Sleep, the power button and the lid still work.
queue.notificationsHelp: A notification when a job is done or fails.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageHelp: The language of the user interface.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.logLevelHelp: How much Reframe writes to its app log. Detailed makes the log grow fastest. A change applies at once.
diagnostics.logsFolderHelp: Holds the app log (reframe.log), a log for each job and sidecar.log.
diagnostics.logsFolderHelpWeb: On the server's computer. Holds the app log (reframe.log) and a log for each job.
diagnostics.logsFolderFailed: The logs folder could not be read: {reason}
diagnostics.copyHelp: Copies a report for a bug report: the app version, the system, the tools, the encoders and the settings. It holds no password or token.
diagnostics.copyFailed: The clipboard refused the diagnostics. Select the report below and copy it.
diagnostics.readFailed: The diagnostics could not be read: {reason}

builds.none: This release offers no FFmpeg build for this computer.
builds.factsNoArchive: FFmpeg {version} · no download for this computer · licence {license}
builds.offlineDesktop: The download server cannot be reached. Install the build from an archive file that you downloaded on another computer, or choose the path of an FFmpeg that you already have.
builds.offlineWeb: The download server cannot be reached. Install the build from an archive file in a media folder of the server, or set the path of an FFmpeg in the server's environment or settings file.
builds.shadowed: The build is installed, but another FFmpeg comes first and is used: {path} ({origin})
